phoneme_focus: Contrastive stress in cleft focus; intonation across 'It was X that…'

grammar_point.title: Cleft mastery (it-cleft, wh-cleft, all-cleft, there-cleft)
grammar_point.en: Full command of all cleft types to package and emphasise information precisely: It was… that; What… is; All… is; The reason… is; There is… that.
grammar_point.ar: إتقان كامل لكل أنواع الجُمَل المشقوقة لتغليف المعلومة وتوكيدها بدقّة: It was… that؛ What… is؛ All… is؛ The reason… is.

vocabulary.example: It was patience that won the day.
It is she who decides.
What we need is clarity.
What she did was resign.
All I ask is honesty.
The reason it failed is cost.
The thing that worries me is time.
The place where it began is here.
There was one thing that troubled me.
It is not until dusk that it cools.
A cleft splits one clause into two.
The cleft marks the focus.
The cleft carries a presupposition.
Clefts set up a contrast.
The wh-cleft highlights the action.
The it-cleft pinpoints the culprit.
The cleft singles out one factor.
Clefts identify what matters.
It was luck that we attribute it to.
The structure underscores the cause.
It was one pivotal choice that changed all.
What proved decisive was timing.
The crux is trust.
What matters, in essence, is intent.
The nub of the matter is money.
What is a priority is safety.
It is care that is the hallmark here.
It is trust that is the linchpin.
The whole case is on that hinge.
What matters most is honesty.
What it comes down to is trust.

Saturday.prompt: Emphasise five facts with it-clefts ('It was X that/who…').

Sunday.prompt: Rework five ideas as wh-clefts ('What we need is…', 'What she did was…').

Monday.prompt: Use 'All I ask is…' and 'The reason… is…' clefts.

Tuesday.prompt: Introduce a key point with 'There was one thing that…'.

Wednesday.prompt: Correct a mistaken belief using a contrastive it-cleft.

Thursday.prompt: Make a precise point to a partner, choosing the best cleft for emphasis.

Friday.prompt: Present an argument (10-12 sentences) using at least four different cleft types.

writing_prompts: Write five it-clefts emphasising different sentence elements.
Write five wh-clefts ('What… is…', 'What… did was…').
Write 'All… is…' and 'The reason… is…' clefts.
Write a there-cleft introducing a key point.
Correct a misconception with a contrastive it-cleft.
Write a precise paragraph using at least four different cleft structures.
